Checked (Nov 6): no independent second source found. lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010 lists it at 18 Church St., Mountain View; it is now at 1758 Marich Way, so it moved after Aug 2010 (dated below). Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) date the move: then at 1211 St. Joseph Avenue, Los Altos (Sept 2015); at the present address by Aug 2019, so it moved there between Sept 2015 and Aug 2019.
